args.request: Adversarially test the current dealership as a user with very little technical knowledge. Reproduce consequential failures, challenge the interpretation, research bounded alternatives and implement supported improvements locally. Fix name/year search order/spacing with precision controls and source identifier compatibility; recover incompatible game/variant/category filters without erasing available restrictions; preserve usable sidebar/list space with keyboard-operable optional filters; implement native Enter submission, visible provider disclosure and honest cancellation/pending/timeout recovery; correct diagnostic paths and documentation. Preserve unrelated dirty work, independent working models, source assets, compiled catalog and existing vendor/provider dependencies. Save findings, counterevidence, coverage, experiments, decisions and limitations. Review raw diffs against captured dirty task baseline and real current check/browser evidence. No publication authorized; no new execution dependency added. Full final72check suite has passed with no skips; external/provider, screen-reader, real-device and game-fidelity limits remain explicit. All model disagreements/escalations are preserved and resolved independently where required.

--- /dev/null
+++ b/research/dealership-teardown-2026-10-12.md
@@ -0,0 +1,77 @@
+# Dealership teardown and improvements — 2026-10-12
+
+This executed teardown targets the supplied dealership at `6c9cc06a068f2d276bd41820f15eb9922af76e7a`, including the existing GT4 branch work. It improves finding cars and recovering from mistakes without guessing undecoded identities or replacing the renderer. The task branch is `bugfix/dealership-forgiving-browsing`. Changes are local; no issue, PR, deployment or message to others was published.
+
+The simulated persona has very little technical knowledge, misses instructions, types familiar name/year combinations, presses Enter and expects obvious recovery. This follows the user's explicit request. The observable task is to find a car, inspect it, retrieve its working GLB and recover from an empty list or failed load. A simulated reaction—“I typed the car and year; why does it say there are none?”—is a probe explanation, not participant evidence or a population preference.
+
+## Baseline, authority and budget
+
+Project guidance: `CONTRIBUTING.md`, `CODING_STANDARDS.md`, dealership editing guide and `docs/agents/review-workflow.md`. Documentation commits to independent working models/downloads, offline selectors/name search, view controls and recoverable data/model failures. Word-order tolerance, contextual filter resets and progressive disclosure are justified improvements rather than pre-existing explicit promises. Full game-render fidelity and undecoded vehicle identities are not promised.
+
+The [baseline receipt](evidence/dealership-teardown-2026-10-12/baseline.json) records the revision, initial dirty state, skill paths/hashes and runtimes. The pre-existing research index changes, `.claude/`, reversing note/evidence and car-generator evidence were preserved. The research index was extended from its dirty baseline. No working GLB, catalog, compiled data or vendor library was changed. Source/binary assets were kept out of model judgment inputs; research used public sources and non-sensitive local probes. No credentials were read or disclosed. The optional server was started with provider-key environment variables removed; its Python reported the SDK unavailable. That is an observed environment limit, not a claim of an empty home or an isolated new-package installation.
+
+Environment: local macOS, Python 3.14.7, Node 26.9.0, isolated Chromium contexts. Browser widths were measured rather than inferred: 1710×832, 1024×600, 900×500 and 375×667 mobile emulation. An attempted resize to 375 was clamped to 500; only later device emulation establishes the 375 measurement. Real touch hardware, screen readers, other browsers and Node 22 were not exercised. The suite's existing pinned Blender route was exercised.
+
+Initial budget: 45 minutes investigation/research, 45 minutes implementation/verification. Primary-source research was delegated under the research skill; the implementer retained product changes and an independent stronger reviewer handled consequential Jev uncertainty. The baseline full suite took about 847 seconds. Investigation stopped expanding once search/filter/layout and request-recovery failures had concrete reproductions; capacity was reserved for the final full suite, review and evidence verification.
+
+## Stable requirements and coverage map
+
+| ID / workflow | Observable acceptance | Final coverage / evidence |
+| --- | --- | --- |
+| R01 First use and catalog | Documented local HTTP route loads the compiled catalog and a default preview; retry recovers from unavailable data | Tested: E01; baseline/final check logs; E12/E12a one-shot HTTP failure |
+| R02 Finding a car | Name/year words in either order find the two known 1968 Mustangs; impossible combinations remain empty; source-code searches preserve discoverability | Tested: E02 before, research experiment, real final replay and `test_dealership`; all 1,715 IDs covered by consumer assertions |
+| R03 Filter recovery | Changing games/variants clears only impossible variant/group/style selections, names the reset and retains available restrictions/name query | Tested: E04a before; E11 after; actual reconciliation tests for GT4/GT/Redline/all-games. Genuine empty intersections retained |
+| R04 Preview and download | Correct named preview loads; view buttons work; working download bytes match compiled hash | Tested samples from all five games: E16 plus Ford Mustang bytes. Renderer/import/resource regressions cover broader corpora; no all-car visual-fidelity claim |
+| R05 Layout and keyboard | At 900×500 the list has ≥120px, optional controls remain reachable by sidebar scroll; mobile has no horizontal overflow; native disclosure/form/view controls respond to keyboard | Tested: E07/E08a before, E13/E15 and screenshots after. Real keyboard Space/Enter; focus placement assisted. Screen-reader, physical-touch and cross-browser coverage untested |
+| R06 Optional query lifecycle | Enter submits once; edits/manual filters/clear invalidate obsolete responses, abort browser fetch, clear pending status and enable submission; errors/timeouts preserve filter state | Tested local exact phrases: E10; abort-aware fixture E14; delayed-response/invalid-pair/timeout regression controls. Hosted provider inference untested: SDK unavailable in test server |
+| R07 Privacy and burden | Provider routing is visible beside query before submission; native search/selectors remain offline; no new execution dependency | Tested/inspected: E10/E15, native form markup, public research. No network provider call used for product probes; existing credentialed optional provider remains a baseline constraint |
+| R08 Asset compatibility | UI improvements do not overwrite independent models/source assets or stale compiled data; existing required checks still pass | Full suite and read-only freshness/real Blender round trips. Game-runtime fidelity, newly decoded parts and exporter redesign excluded because these changes do not alter geometry/material recovery |
+
+Information-processing coverage uses the committed 1,715-entry catalog and frozen positive/negative queries as its reference proxy. This measures lookup completeness separately from precision; it does not measure general natural-language understanding, aliases or typo correction. No retrieval sources, hidden results, pagination or formats were added. The existing model/data validation and transport controls remain in the check suite.
+
+## Findings, counterevidence and disposition
+
+Each row is an independently fixable problem. Impact, evidence, type and disposition are separate. Classification uses the explicit rule that recoverable convention-based effort is friction; an observed stale lifecycle state or wrong diagnostic path is a defect; visibility beyond an existing tooltip is an improvement, not proof of a leak. This resolves Jev's mixed type distributions without inflating severity.
+
+| Finding / requirement | Expected basis → actual and smallest reproduction | Competing explanation and falsifying probe | Type / impact / evidence | Action, acceptance and disposition |
+| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
+| F01 / R02 Search order and spacing | Name/year lookup should tolerate ordinary combined terms (proposed usability expectation). Type `mustang 1968`: zero despite two known cars; `mustang` returns 15. E02 | “Name **or** year” can reasonably mean a literal single query. That narrows the defect claim, but the known corpus/control establishes avoidable effort. Reverse order, repeated spaces and impossible year distinguish it from missing cars | Demonstrated friction; substantial recoverable search burden; observed execution + code; restricted to tested queries | All-token word-prefix search plus literal lookup. Both orders/spacing/punctuation return exactly two; impossible/nonsense stay zero; complete codes discoverable. Fixed and verified |
+| F02 / R03 Incompatible selectors | Changing games should expose their available variants (proposed recovery expectation). Select GT/Night, then GT4: Night remains, zero results. E04a | Empty may be an intended intersection; switching to Showroom reveals 730, and Clear works. Retain a still-available Night across all-games/GT to falsify overbroad clearing | Demonstrated friction; substantial recoverable burden; reproduced native selector actions and catalog facts | Disable impossible variants/chips; clear incompatible selections and announce names; retain query/valid restrictions. E11 returns 730, Night cleared. Fixed and verified |
+| F03 / R05 Sidebar starves list | Browsing must remain usable at a constrained desktop height. At 900×500, sidebar scroll height 649; list only 16px at y633 and reset below viewport. E07 | Main body can scroll and mobile layout differs, so this is not a universal page lockout. Measure the actual sidebar/list and open/close optional controls, rather than infer from one screenshot | Demonstrated friction; substantial recoverable browsing burden; observed rectangles and pixels | More filters disclosure, grouped chips, bounded sidebar scrolling, ≥120px list. Final collapsed list163px at y337; expanded120px with own scroll. Fixed and verified |
+| F04 / R06 Enter does nothing | Single-field query follows native form convention. Enter leaves status and selectors unchanged; clicking starts a request. E05 | Not an explicit Enter promise; button activation already works. Real Enter on the final native form is the discriminating probe, not HTML documentation alone | Demonstrated friction; minor keyboard burden; real browser action, local server after change | Native form/submit handler; visible purpose and hint. E10 applies GT/Night with URL unchanged. Fixed and verified |
+| F05 / R06 Abandoned pending status | Once an obsolete result is discarded, the status must stop implying active work. Start delayed query, edit its text: final “Interpreting…” remains after response. E09a | Result invalidation itself already protects current filters; fixture cannot prove hosted latency. Observe status after the delayed result and test signal abortion separately | Confirmed lifecycle defect; minor misleading-state burden; actual handler under explicit delayed transport fixture | Abort obsolete browser fetch, clear status and restore submit; preserve stale-response guards. E14 and callback tests pass. Fixed and verified; server-side provider cancellation is not promised |
+| F06 / R07 Routing disclosure hidden in title | Contextual provider disclosure should be visible before deliberate sending (privacy improvement). Before: title/accessible description only; screenshots lack persistent notice | Existing tooltip and docs disclose routing; no data leak was observed. Inspect final visible text and accessible association without sending private input | Justified capability/usability improvement; impact not assigned as a leak; observed markup/pixels + primary guidance | Visible label/help under More filters, `aria-describedby`; exact-local versus optional-provider routing stated. Implemented and verified within markup/browser scope |
+| F07 / R01 Wrong recovery path | Diagnostic instructions must identify existing project paths. Catalog503 message says `viewer/public/...` although this project uses `dealership/public/...`; classic startup guard repeats old paths | Could be a leftover deployment alias; repository files and working local server use dealership. Test current retry and inspect every dealership guard path | Confirmed diagnostic defect; minor recovery burden; HTTP error + exact path existence/source | Correct all dealership guard/error paths; retry retained. Fixed and verified |
+| F08 / R06 Optional API on static server | Clicking optional query with basic static server reports missing API and names `serve_library.py`. E06 | Editing guide explicitly requires this server for the optional API; deterministic controls still work. Running the documented server supports exact phrases without credentials | Rejected defect hypothesis; no demonstrated outage within the documented API route; explicit counterevidence | Retain clear failure guidance, document both server modes. Rejected as defect; discoverability improved with visible hint |
+
+Existing design choices retained: literal archive IDs where retail identities remain undecoded, explicit unknown performance/body styles, independent asset ownership, approximate Ford icon tones, native downloads and error/retry controls. Guessing identities, masking unknown metadata or rewriting shading would exceed the established evidence for this UI task. Existing geometry/fidelity open items remain indexed separately.
+
+## Experiments, decisions and rejected variants
+
+| ID → decision/change | Hypothesis, control and adversarial cases | Result / consequence |
+| --- | --- | --- |
+| X01 → D01/F01 | Compare original contiguous substring with all-token search over the same real catalog. Freeze Mustang/year orders, repeated spaces, nonsense and single-word/empty controls before editing | Positive cases0→2; `mustang`15 unchanged; empty1715 unchanged; impossible1967/nonsense0 unchanged. Research prototype is a consumer experiment, not final browser proof |
+| X02 → D02/F01 refinement | Holdout `f 150` should retrieve the three F-150 entries. All-token substring candidate versus word-prefix candidate | Initial substring candidate returned4, including Triumph Spitfire1500. Rejected that candidate; prefix refinement returns3 in actual final page and regression. Literal single-term substring behavior retained |
+| X03 → D03/F02 | Change GT/Night→GT4; preserve GT/Night across all-games and GT; compare available catalog variants and genuine name/style restrictions | Clear only unavailable variant/chips, announce removal. 0→730; valid restrictions preserved. Unknown styles remain excluded rather than guessed |
+| X04 → D04/F03 | Same900×500 viewport, optional filters closed/open, keyboard Space on native summary. Negative control375×667 horizontal overflow | List16→163px collapsed; expanded120px and sidebar overflow auto.375 emulation no horizontal overflow; mobile list92→140px. Focus set directly for keyboard probe; no screen-reader claim |
+| X05 → D05/F04–05 | Original Enter versus native form on credential-removed local server; delayed/stale and abort-aware transport fixtures; real callback timer; nonexistent suggested pair | Live exact phrase applies with Enter. Fixture request count1, signal aborted, pending cleared/button enabled/game unchanged. Timer35000ms allows existing30s provider budget; injected timeout leaves filters unchanged. Hosted provider path remains untested |
+| X06 → D06/R01,R04 | Disposable one-shot real catalog/model503 controls versus normal files served after retry; source/model hashes as output controls | Catalog retry and same-model retry succeed. Five-game sample previews load; working GLB response bytes match each compiled SHA-256. No file mutation used for faults |
+| X07 → D07/R07 | Retain current, native improvement, or Fuse fuzzy integration; primary docs/source and adverse behavior evidence | Select native implementation. Fuse was not installed/executed and has no demonstrated additional benefit; eligibility incomplete, kept out. No new runtime/build/dev/test dependency added |
+
+The [alternatives note](dealership-usability-alternatives-2026-10-12.md) records source URLs, versions, mechanisms, cost/auth/maintenance/license limits and measured prototype benefit. Current fetched Fuse main reports7.6.0-beta.0/Apache-2.0, rather than a remembered historical MIT license. No candidate requiring a new account, key or service was integrated; eligibility is not claimed for unexecuted Fuse. Existing TypeSafe/OpenRouter is an optional baseline dependency, not a new approved addition. Research used existing configured judgment tools only.
+
+Tradeoffs: advanced filters now need one disclosure action; the collapsed summary identifies active chips. Incompatible selector changes deliberately clear impossible restrictions and announce them. Multiword search uses word prefixes rather than fuzzy matching; misspellings/aliases remain unsupported. User edits abort browser transport but server work may continue until its existing budget expires, so a new request may get the existing busy response. The dealership regression went from0.830s in the baseline run to2.903s in the final run, including all-ID/new recovery controls; these are single command observations, not a stable performance benchmark. The page removes its repeated linear car lookup by retaining each row's car reference; no UI latency speedup is claimed.
+
+## Evidence ledger and judgment boundaries
+
+Detailed evidence lives in [the evidence directory](evidence/dealership-teardown-2026-10-12/). Stable links: [E01 setup/assistance](evidence/dealership-teardown-2026-10-12/E01-first-use.txt), [E02 search](evidence/dealership-teardown-2026-10-12/E02-search-order.json), [E04a variants](evidence/dealership-teardown-2026-10-12/E04a-stale-variant-confirmed.json), [E07 layout](evidence/dealership-teardown-2026-10-12/E07-cramped-sidebar.json), [E09a pending status](evidence/dealership-teardown-2026-10-12/E09a-stale-pending-confirmed.json), [E10 Enter](evidence/dealership-teardown-2026-10-12/E10-live-enter.json), [E11 variant recovery](evidence/dealership-teardown-2026-10-12/E11-recovered-variants.json), [E12 retry](evidence/dealership-teardown-2026-10-12/E12-http-retry.json), [E13 final layout](evidence/dealership-teardown-2026-10-12/E13-final-short-layout.json), [E14 cancellation](evidence/dealership-teardown-2026-10-12/E14-final-cancellation.json), [E15 keyboard](evidence/dealership-teardown-2026-10-12/E15-expanded-keyboard-layout.json), [E16 representative games](evidence/dealership-teardown-2026-10-12/E16-five-game-workflow.json). Earlier E04/E08/E09 harness limits are retained and explicitly superseded by their `a` receipts.
+
+Jev is advisory evidence interpretation, not independent runtime corroboration. Plan judgments supported persona fit 0.86 but were uncertain about the compressed task grounding 0.44 and route leakage 0.70; host resolved against documented preview/download/search interfaces and goal-only persona wording. J02 probe ranking valued layout/search most but unexpectedly ranked filter recovery 0.11 despite its reproduction; the host retained the concrete evidence. J03 verified both initial search/variant claims (support 0.98/0.96). J05 returned mixed type distributions; the explicit finding-type rule above resolves classification while keeping measured facts separate. J06 chose native token search 0.97, confidence 0.96, no contradicted requirements; X02 subsequently rejected its broad substring implementation and narrowed the semantics. J08 rejected server-side cancellation inference with probability 0.02 and limited layout claims to tested widths.
+
+Public source screens passed; the research note preserves all raw distributions and a provider 400 error followed by a repaired bounded verification. No unavailable/error judgment is counted as a pass. J07 Enter/cancellation claim verification returned `verified` but review with low support/confidence; the research compound conditional-HTML claim also required review. The [independent stronger review](evidence/dealership-teardown-2026-10-12/independent-claim-review.json) resolved all three with explicit boundaries, retained the original distributions, reran the dealership regression and independently confirmed the local exact phrase with keys removed/SDK absent. It found no material product-patch concerns. Enter attribution uses saved action notes plus the outcome, not a raw key-event trace; cancellation remains browser/fixture-only. J09 raw-patch review then escalated: composite 0.74175, safe-to-apply 0.50, blast-radius confidence 0.40. The [independent product review](evidence/dealership-teardown-2026-10-12/independent-product-review.json) approved this unchanged patch with file/diff hashes, scoped asset preservation, actual checks and UI evidence. All original scores/thresholds remain recorded. The final patch/claim gate is separate. No recursive or unrelated calls were made to inflate usage. Extraction/audit tools were unnecessary because field values came from deterministic JSON/DOM reads rather than model-written extraction.
+
+## Verification and completion state
+
+Exact baseline command: `tools/check.sh --evidence-dir .scratch/dealership-teardown-2026-10-12/baseline-checks` — 72/72 pass, exit 0, no skips, about 847 seconds. Complete retained logs are in [baseline-checks](evidence/dealership-teardown-2026-10-12/baseline-checks/). Focused command: `tools/check.sh --only test_dealership,test_native_catalog_ui,test_mc3_preview_ui,test_viewer_loading,test_library_filter,test_serve_library --evidence-dir .scratch/dealership-teardown-2026-10-12/focused-checks` — 6/6 pass; [complete logs](evidence/dealership-teardown-2026-10-12/focused-checks/). Final command: `tools/check.sh --evidence-dir .scratch/dealership-teardown-2026-10-12/final-checks` — 72/72 pass, exit 0, no skips, about 888 seconds; [manifest and complete logs](evidence/dealership-teardown-2026-10-12/final-checks/). This includes actual configured private-input verifiers, GT4 catalog/extraction, dealership freshness, and dealership/Redline/MC3 Blender round trips. `git diff --check` passed. Model/source preservation is checked by freshness/roundtrip tests and absence of asset changes in the final worktree diff.
+
+All accepted changes are implemented and the final checks pass. The completion verdict, elapsed task time and final review/gate resolution are recorded in [final-completion.json](evidence/dealership-teardown-2026-10-12/final-completion.json). That record is finalized only after raw-patch review and gate concerns are resolved. Live hosted semantic inference, real mobile hardware, assistive technology, other browser/platform runtimes and all-car visual fidelity remain explicit nonessential coverage gaps. The source viewer's optional disclosure/timeout remains an indexed separate open item; this task targets the dealership. No claim of perfection, exhaustive coverage or general user benefit is made.
